name: Mobi Notice Dock
author: mobiplugin

sections.description:
Plugin and theme nags stack under the admin bar. This plugin hides them and keeps a Notices button at the bottom right of the admin screen.

  • Enable / disable hiding
  • Control who it applies to
  • Optional handling for error notices
  • Same hiding on the Updates screen; WordPress update tables stay put
  • Does not move page content, and does not watch the admin page for changes
  • Keeps plugin list rows, plugin cards, and Loco Translate in-page notices visible
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate.
  2. Open Settings → Mobi Notice Dock, or use Settings on the Plugins row.
sections.changelog:
1.1.4

  • Do not hide the new application password notice.

1.1.3

  • Hide third-party nags on the Updates screen as well. Leave the WordPress update tables in place.

1.1.2

  • Restore the bottom-right Notices button without watching the whole admin page.

1.1.1

  • Move settings under Settings → Mobi Notice Dock, with a Plugins row Settings link.
  • Hide plugin-list license notices and XStore message boxes.
  • Show hidden notices in the Notices list on the settings screen.

1.1.0

  • Hide standard admin notices with CSS instead of moving them with JavaScript.
  • Show those notices on the Hide Notices screen.
  • Fix the settings save redirect.

1.0.10

  • Collect nested third-party nags at any depth under the admin content area (PixelYourSite Help, license key, review, and telemetry boxes).
  • Keep panel items visible and badge count in sync with rows in the panel.

1.0.7

  • Fix empty Admin notices panel when the badge still showed a count.
  • Dock theme / API connection nags (for example XStore SSL or whitelist warnings).
  • Keep Plugins screen rows and row-actions untouched.

1.0.6

  • Do not treat Plugins screen rows or row-action links as admin notices.
  • Keep the notice badge count in sync with items shown in the panel.

1.0.5

  • Catch more third-party admin notices and license nags, including late-injected banners.

1.0.2

  • Fix over-aggressive collect that could hide report / plugin UI.

1.0.1

  • Hide notices from first paint; collect custom page-level nags (Digits / PixelYourSite style).

1.0.0

  • First public free release as Mobi Notice Dock.
